author: KEXP
description: Kansas-based band Sweeping Promises move at a frenetic pace on their latest release 'You Say I Romanticize.' Delivering a set of high-energy art-punk, the band share a performance of "Rapture, Or…" and more Live on KEXP.
title: Sweeping Promises performs "Rapture, Or..." & more Live on KEXP
